# Persian fonts

The unmodified files `BKoodakBold.woff` and `BTitrBold.woff` were obtained from
[`micro-persian-fonts` 0.6.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/micro-persian-fonts).
The package archive was downloaded over HTTPS from the npm registry, and its
SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm's published package metadata.

Upstream package: https://github.com/sav68/micro-persian-fonts

The package's MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE.micro-persian-fonts.txt`.
The font files retain their original embedded notices:

> (c) 2000 Borna Rayaneh
> Parsa 2001® - Borna Rayaneh®

The package license is a notice from the package distributor; it is not an
independent grant from the original font designer. Check the font owner's
redistribution terms before publishing a commercial distribution.

Verified font identities: **B Koodak**, Bold; **B Titr**, Bold. Both include
Persian glyphs and have an OpenType embedding permission field (`fsType`) of 0.
No fallback font has been renamed to one of these families.

SHA-256:

```text
BKoodakBold.woff  8fb026de716f20524a37417467cad327bc244b00dcae34d257b31ff87a515b37
BTitrBold.woff    035d53509ddaacd1e46dfa3f2be1ec8f88b89ca5d1f692b5c41e750ff9facc49
```
